stem: Meena's father in Pune has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. The doctor explains how the family should manage his condition. Which statement gives the correct approach to controlling this non-communicable disease?

options.text: One complete course of diabetes medicine will cure him permanently, so no further care is needed.
Reducing his physical activity will lower his risk of heart disease.
He needs continuous care, regular checkups, a balanced diet, and daily exercise to manage the disease.
Since he looks healthy, he does not need regular checkups or any change in lifestyle.

teacher.key_rationale: Non-communicable diseases such as type 2 diabetes are controlled, not cured: management requires continuous care, early diagnosis and regular checkups, medication, and lifestyle changes in diet and physical activity. A, B and D each deny some element of sustained management or reverse the activity-risk relation. Key C.
